extraction.method: Partition source triangles by nearest X/Y cell center after deterministic three-cluster 1D k-means. Grid axes are X columns and Y-up rows; output order is the visually audited front view from top-left to bottom-right.
extraction.faceAssignment: Each source triangle is assigned once by its centroid. Each candidate remaps only referenced source vertices while preserving each source triangle corner sequence and exact position, normal, and UV values.

preliminaryDesignReview.recommendation: Hold A for the serious RPG direction: oversized grins/eyes and a repeated cartoon imp template.
